appTagline: Trusted youth health stories, videos, and support in Rwanda
heroTitle: Watch free health videos, ask questions, and find verified care
heroBody: Nsobanuza brings together trusted Rwandan health bodies, youth-friendly videos, and a simple wellness toolkit in one mobile-first experience.
adminBoostHint: When enabled, posts marked Sponsored move higher in the home feed to simulate paid promotion by certified health bodies.
noPosts: No posts match this search yet.
adBannerTitle: Health information stays free for everyone
adBannerBody: Watch one simulated video ad and hide banner ads for the next 24 hours.
videosIntro: Browse short explainers on SRH, mental health, consent, HIV prevention, and period care.
aiIntro: Ask questions in Kinyarwanda, English, or French about sexual health, reproductive health, mental health, consent, and relationships.
aiDisclaimer: If Nsobo is unsure, it will tell you to consult a verified provider on Nsobanuza.
trackerIntro: Log your period start date, mood, and symptoms. Nsobanuza predicts your next period using a simple 28-day cycle.
noTracking: Add at least one entry to see your tracker history and prediction.
providersIntro: Connect with trusted Rwandan SRH and mental health professionals in a lightweight consultation flow.
mockConsultation: This is a demo consultation space. Share your concern and the provider will reply with a mock response.
providerAutoReply: Thank you for reaching out. This is a demo consultation reply. A real product would continue the conversation securely here.
